thread:
zoe: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need owners and dates for regression seeding, canonical prompt sets, load reproduction, and chaos drill automation. Suggested: raj=regression, claire=prompts, tobias=load, mira=chaos. Thoughts?

raj: I can own regression seeding. I'll pull the failing requests, normalise them, and add unit + e2e cases. Plan nightly staging run. ETA: Thu EOD for first batch.

claire: Prompt curation OK. I'll extract ~10 representative prompts from traces and tag them as regression/flake. Want an acceptance test that runs on canary for each deploy. ETA: Fri.

tobias: Load repro: will build a k6 scenario that mimics the seq-len skew and ramp profile. Need a small off-peak node pool; @sre_bot can you provision?

sre_bot: Provision request received. Temporary 4-node preemptible pool scheduled for maintenance window. Artifacts exported to s3://redwood-incidents/2245/kv-eviction/artifacts.tar.gz

mira: Chaos plan: tabletop Wed 20m, then KV eviction in lab next Tue with guards. I'll draft a short playbook and rollback steps.

zoe: Great. I'll update the postmortem board with owners and tentative dates and create the invites. Add any blockers to the doc.

raj: Blocker: need the exact traces and failing payloads to seed tests. @sre_bot please confirm artifact location.

sre_bot: Artifacts posted to s3://redwood-incidents/2245/kv-eviction/artifacts.tar.gz and gs://redwood-ci/2245/trace-dump.zip

claire: With those I'll pick prompts and start the labeling schema.

tobias: I'll submit a small job manifest by EOD for the node carve-out.

mira: I'll open the playbook PR and add the tabletop invite.

zoe: Closing loop: owners raj/claire/tobias/mira. Sync tomorrow 11:30 to confirm scope.
